goals: Maintain one Fabric mod, source tree, build, version, and deployable JAR for the absorbed Nibaru native material catalog and all BGE geometry.
Preserve every former Nibaru and BGE registry/resource identity, specialized material behavior, and saved-world reference while CNM remains an unchanged external dependency.
Expose one deterministic ordered geometry catalog for Vertical Slab, Step, Corner, Quarter Column, and Layer without changing established placement, economy, or material-frame semantics.

Offer complete nine-role BGE geometry families for the exact 76 requested optional-provider sources only when Ribbits, Mynx Trees, Macaw's Paths, or Building But Better supplies the corresponding source block.
scope: Compile the retained `games.twinhead.moreslabsstairsandwalls` source and `more_slabs_stairs_and_walls` resources directly inside BGE with a clear LGPL-covered source and attribution boundary.
Register native slabs, stairs, walls, material profiles, transitions, and client bindings before deriving CNM/BGE geometry through one guarded bootstrap and one root Fabric descriptor.

Preserve all native material profiles, canonical parents, copied settings, TOP/SIDE/BOTTOM roles, axes, patterns, tint, translucency, transitions, drops, and specialized behaviors; C62 corrects the wall-material, canonical-role duplication, leaf-wall, and plain-Path seams demonstrated by exact C61 runtime evidence, C63 corrects external axis-family inventory previews, C64 adds the complete BBB beam catalog, C65 corrects its demonstrated BBB production axis-resource classification failure, C66 gives compatible Quarter Columns Step-equivalent full-cell continuation targeting without changing their physical geometry, C68 preserves one-to-one texel density for axis-material Layer faces without changing their geometry or grain orientation, C69 restores independent material axes to the canonical BBB Beam Slab and Beam Stair, C70 restores vanilla Stone slab ownership, and C71 mirrors Minecraft 26.2 horizontal-slab tilling and Farmland lifecycle semantics.

Generate one Layer, Corner, and Quarter Column per supported canonical family while preserving Vertical Slab and Step, deterministic selector order, one-source economy, orientation, waterlogging, collision, and drops.
Provide primary Fabric ID `cnm_terrain_slabs_compat` and verified legacy alias `more_slabs_stairs_and_walls` from the same mod container and shared version `4.2.15-bge.canary71.farmland-slab+26.2`.

Preserve C58 native registry/resource identities while exposing one canonical nine-role family per exact optional source variant: 52 Macaw patterned full blocks, five distinct Macaw soil Path blocks, Ribbits Mossy Oak Planks, six Mynx Trees log, wood, and leaf sources, and all 12 BBB beam parents including Pale Oak. BBB's original slab and stair registrations remain untouched, but their provider state is geometry-only and cannot carry an independent material AXIS; C69 therefore gives BGE canonical AxisSlab and AxisStairs forms, retains BBB's ordinary thin WoodenWallBlock as the canonical wall, and keeps the five other BGE axis-aware roles. C65 accepts BBB's real semantically equivalent `axis=z` `x=90,y=180` representation while rejecting unknown transforms and `uvlock`.

exclusions: Clutter No More source and artifacts remain external and unchanged; its ShapeMap remains the canonical family and switching mechanism.
C58 is limited to the user-authored glass-Corner geometry/UV route; generic glass Quarter Column projection and all non-glass Corner outputs remain C57-equivalent.

C68 changes only normal axis-material Layer face UV rectangles: it preserves Layer bounds, placement, collision, state, texture roles, grain rotation, special visual paths, non-axis materials, all other geometries, registration, data, display transforms, and external-material support.
`projects/bge-ctm`, shaders, resource-pack classification, BBB source/assets, and unrelated consumer projects are outside this consolidation.
Accepted BGE C52 and historical standalone Nibaru C45 are preserved as rollback provenance and are not rewritten.

C71 owns only horizontal-slab hoe conversion and Farmland lifecycle/state; crop placement, crop growth, partial-height projection, targeting, particles, and rendering remain deferred to Slab Decorations.
